headline_marked: Apple iOS 18 brings [[Siri AI to the public]] in beta
headline: Apple iOS 18 brings Siri AI to the public in beta
summary: The revamped Siri AI is now available in iOS 18 public beta
details: The latest version of Apple's smartphone software, iOS 18, is available for iPhone owners as a public beta. It's the first time Apple's long-promised revamped version of Siri is available to the general public.
The new Siri AI was showcased at Apple's WWDC event in June and features a chatbot-style app and further integration into the iPhone user experience.
Users can sign up for the Apple Beta Software Program to access the iOS 18 public beta and try out the new Siri AI features.
caption:
Get ready to experience Siri like never before! Apple's iOS 18 public beta is out now

The latest version of Apple's smartphone software, iOS 18, is available for iPhone owners as a public beta. It's the first time Apple's long-promised revamped version of Siri is available to the general public.

The new Siri AI was showcased at Apple's WWDC event in June and features a chatbot-style app and further integration into the iPhone user experience.

Users can sign up for the Apple Beta Software Program to access the iOS 18 public beta and try out the new Siri AI features.

headline_marked: Google Pixel 11 [[to get new volume slider]] in August
headline: Google Pixel 11 to get new volume slider in August
summary: The upcoming Pixel 11 may introduce a new volume slider feature for ringtones, notifications, and alarms. This change was found in an unreleased build of Pixel 11 firmware.
details: The Google Pixel 11 launch is set for August 12 in New York. A new feature discovered in an unreleased build of Pixel 11 firmware could bring a slider to more sections that need volume adjustments for their audio components.

The change, uncovered by Android Authority, currently applies to ringtones, notification sounds, and alarm sections. There are also other customizations in the works, but they weren't able to be activated.

It's always exciting to see new features pop up in the code, but it's essential to note that these are works in progress. There's a chance that we could see it in the next update, or we may never see it at all.
caption:
Will the Pixel 11's new volume slider change your audio experience?

The Google Pixel 11 launch is set for August 12 in New York. A new feature discovered in an unreleased build of Pixel 11 firmware could bring a slider to more sections that need volume adjustments for their audio components.

The change, uncovered by Android Authority, currently applies to ringtones, notification sounds, and alarm sections. There are also other customizations in the works, but they weren't able to be activated.

It's always exciting to see new features pop up in the code, but it's essential to note that these are works in progress. There's a chance that we could see it in the next update, or we may never see it at all.
